fullSequence: Owned header reader/adapter -> versioned explicit-source/declaration semantic producer -> typed coverage -> actual typed diagnostic consumer -> separately bound authoring. This prerequisite does not complete A10.

rpc.name: public.read_requirement_relationship_context
rpc.selection: Null resolves current under the same owned snapshot; explicit historical versions remain independent of current review/head proof caps. Selected versions and captured latest heads are distinct.
rpc.permissions: SECURITY DEFINER, empty search_path, fully qualified access; revoke PUBLIC/anon/authenticated and grant only service_role. Reuse established server ownership/privacy/membership checks. All private helpers remain denied.

adapter.options: Strict canonicalVersionId/requirementVersionId UUID|null optional; normalize omitted to null; invalid input fails before RPC. No caller context/proof/eligibility fields.
adapter.transport: One exact RPC, no table fallback or hidden query. Sanitize DB errors; do not return/log raw messages or private content on failure.
adapter.decoder: Strict available/not_found/unavailable protocol union; parse actual canonical/evidence/typed-JD schemas, exact owner/source/version/head/citation/location/profile bindings. Native hashes are opaque PG JSONB-text UTF8 SHA256, never JSON.stringify hashes.

dto.status: available | not_found | unavailable; failure branches contain only protocol/status/scoringEligible:false
dto.authority: owned_header_relations_only (available branch only); no semantic or numeric eligibility
dto.sourceMetadata: {pageCount: actual nullable bounded positive integer from owned resume_versions.page_count}; no observed-page substitution or clamp
dto.requirements: {versionId,revision,inputSha256,contentSha256,content}; typed requirements/2.0.0 validated with actual JD validator and admission/alias/relation/unicode policies
dto.ancestors: Ordered actual owned suffix <=64; versionId/revision/native contentSha256/content. Exact predecessor IDs and decrementing revisions; never fabricated ancestry.
dto.heads: {canonicalHeadId,canonicalHeadRevision,requirementHeadId,requirementHeadRevision}; capture and final recheck with selected pair/job link/privacy
dto.profiles: Exact existing correction/association/regroup/JD admission profiles plus guarded canonical readiness successor identity. Publish actual exact nested schema/constants together before test GREEN; no permissive record/unknown fields for security metadata.
dto.headerSnapshot: Derived actual marker family regroup|association|none (preserve empty markers), existing family creation kind/null, selected snapshot through-prefix identity and ordered active groups. No producer-based inference.
dto.groups: Section/entry plus typed origin family,batchId,groupId,originalApprovalVersionId and exact immutable source selection. Members: source order/assertion/field/fact, current value/state/confirmation separate from observed source value, complete citation/page/method/offset tuples, current location and current_citations|owned_ancestor_chain with original version/fact references. Field only employer|role|dates. Publish precise strict source-selection/member wire shape in coherent module before dependent tests.

proof: Use entry_regroup_scope, loaded base/prove_data/links/header/origin/resolve_loaded with ONE invocation cache. Historical through-prefix comes from selected immutable snapshot; never entry_regroup_current. No direct application table privileges or per-group validation wrapper/cache resets. Final pair/head/job-link/active ownership/deletion recheck before return. Missing catalogs, invalid/duplicate/missing members or malformed proof fail closed.
budgets: Preserve exact current aggregate/per-kind/per-base ceilings. Charge added JD/projection/output visits and unique bytes; no origin reset, no new32 active-group ceiling, no silent truncation. No OS-memory/latency guarantee claimed.
readiness: Guard exact preimages/postimages and add actual new reader/helper definitions/attributes/grants to readiness successor. All historical writer denials/bodies and defaults stay. Older verifier receipts remain pinned to their original snapshots; new deferred current-profile verifier must preserve relevant checks, not weaken assertions.
preserve: All existing SQL source, labels, manifests, thresholds and failed receipts.
No table/writer/canonical producer/engine/score weights or user route changes.
Typed scoring503, authoring pause and numeric withholding remain unchanged.
Headers never establish carried skill/contribution/responsibility/duration. Current confirmation differs from observed source support.

ownership.reviewer: pricing_validation: finite read-only wire/SQL/resource/ownership/adapter and counterexample review; no pricing work.
ownership.root: Contract, dependency/ownership synchronization, migration order, shared docs and final integrated affected gate.

acceptance: Real helper-generated canonical/JD fixtures and actual adapter fakeRPC: current/historical/non-head/none/association/regroup/empty-header positives. These are source/mock only.
Cross-owner/root/source/attempt/SHA/version/profile/confirmation/location/citation swaps; missing/duplicate member, prefix or ancestry corruption; no source data in sanitized failures.
Page_count nullable/actual metadata; zero dispatch on invalid input; one exact RPC/no table fallback.
Shared resource/loaded helper source contracts and deferred native cases for scope/privacy/ACL/current-vs-historical/old later-prefix overflow/lifecycle/resource limits. Do not execute SQL.
Relevant source/static checks and one Root affected gate plus full types/lint/web/worker after exact release. No full old campaigns merely to repeat green.
boundaries: No SQL parser/execution/native DB/advisors, hosted writes, real env/keys/PII, services/browser/compiler/Docker/providers/dependencies/Git/deployment. No actual data/operator allocation. Source only.
